question: A dip circle is used to measure the angle of dip at a location where the true angle of dip is $\delta$. If the plane of the dip circle is rotated by an angle $\alpha$ ($0 < \alpha < 90^\circ$) with respect to the magnetic meridian, the needle settles at an apparent dip angle $\delta'$. If the plane is then rotated by $90^\circ$ from this new position, the needle settles at an apparent dip angle $\delta''$. Which of the following relationships correctly connects these angles?
